description: Trigger evals for dv:groom (groom one existing Linear ticket: format check, neighbors, verification, size, split, scouting, interview, approved edits; never starts the work). The should-trigger set carries the phrases David used on 2026-11-18 (groom the ticket, size it, split it up if we have to, admin work first, don't start work yet). Hard near-misses in no_trigger: filing a new ticket (dv:ticket), starting the work, reading a ticket's status, a handoff (dv:handoff) and a plan critique (dv:critique). See tooling/evals/README.md.

queries.q: Groom VIL-123.
Please groom the ticket VIL-810 before anyone picks it up.
Take VIL-402, size it, and tell me whether it's one PR or two.
VIL-77 feels too big. Look it over and split it up if we have to.
Check VIL-88 against our ticket format and tell me what is missing.
Do the admin work first on VIL-530: verify what it says, fix the stale bits, and set its blockers.
Is VIL-210 ready to be worked? Groom it and tell me what's stale. Don't start work yet.
Go through VIL-640, interview me on anything that isn't obvious, and look for follow-up tickets it suggests.
Before we build VIL-301, check its Done means can actually be run and size it.
Review the ticket VIL-415 and tell me if it should be split into separate tickets.
File a ticket for the login page timing out after five minutes.
Start working on VIL-123.
What's the status of VIL-88?
Write a handoff for this session.
Critique my plan for the migration before I build it.
Create a Linear issue to look into why the nightly export is slow.
Mark VIL-210 as Done now that the PR merged.
List the Linear issues assigned to me this week.
Implement VIL-415 and open a PR.
Pick up where the last session left off.
